note: Bases are 2x crops (960x540 -> upscaled 1920x1080) of artifacts/mobsv2-bases. The swarm capture (mobsv2-bases/swarm) shows no root swarm on screen (hero stands in the stone portal ring), so item 02 uses the wendigo capture where two root swarms flank the hero.

items.prompt_summary: Kill moment: the tree-warrior nearest the hero cracks along bark plates and bursts into bark chips, splinters, twigs and leaves radially; brief warm white-gold flash on the body; wood dust; 6-8 gold essence motes arc toward the hero. Second guardian untouched.

items.prompt_summary: Kill moment: small root-swarm right of the hero crumbles into a low spray of rotten wood crumbs, root fibers, dry leaves and soil dust, sags into a heap; brief warm flash; 3-4 gold motes toward the hero. Wendigo, other swarm and red telegraph sector kept.

Kill moment: the lowest bud's red petal cap splits and bursts into golden pollen spores, amber-green sap droplets and splatter, torn petals and leaf bits; warm flash in the center; 3-4 gold motes drift to the hero. Other buds unchanged.

Elite kill moment: wendigo collapses into bone-white antler shards and splinters with clumps of moss and leaves, dust puff, warm flash, stream of 10-12 gold essence motes toward the hero. Red telegraph sector and the thin red line across its body removed (attack cancelled by death).
